allowlist.reason: Archived Expo/React Native toolchain (devDependencies; npm also counts it in --omit=dev because @react-three/fiber lists expo as an optional peer). Root cause is image-size<=2.0.2 under metro 0.83; image-size 2.x drops the callable default export metro's Assets.js requires, and npm's only fix is expo 57 (major). Fix = remove the Expo tree, US-278. Added US-355 2026-09-23.

No patched xlsx on the npm registry (CVE-2023-30533 fixed in 0.19.3, CVE-2024-22363 in 0.20.2; SheetJS publishes those only on cdn.sheetjs.com, which this sandbox's proxy blocks). Replacing it in ScheduleImport.tsx/export-formats.ts/Reports.tsx/WipReport.tsx/CustomReportBuilder.tsx is a source change tracked by US-355 AC2. Added 2026-09-23.

US-355: vite is a devDependency; production is the static build served by Cloudflare Pages, so this dev-server/build-tool advisory (GHSA-4w7w-66w2-5vf9, also via esbuild) does not reach users. The fix is vite 5 -> 8, a major upgrade tracked as its own follow-up.
